criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: Pass. Lid/top face rows 7-17 with the d specular streak, separated by the k groove (row 16) from a south front band now ~10 rows deep (rows 18-28) that darkens k -> m -> i toward the base. No isometric side faces, no plan-view flatness. The deeper front band strengthens the 3/4 read rather than making it look like a block.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Pass. 13 opaque colours + 1 flat shadow (12,10,8,a110); palette unchanged from v8, no near-duplicate ramps (a/i are close darks but used for outline vs inner shade). Dark outline is consistent with context trees and rocks. Only semi-alpha is the soft shadow.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: Pass. In context_x3 it reads clearly as a crashed silver capsule/pod: metallic lid with a long highlight, glass window at the head, cyan crack and emblem, a soot mark at the foot. Not a stone slab, not a screen, not a sticker. The taller head end gives a coffin/pod taper rather than a boulder.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Pass. Sits inside the crater floor; shadow falls S/SE; 48x32 vs ~16x24 hero is a plausible pod/coffin size.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: Pass. Foot column x=46 is outline only on rows 16-20 (5 px), x=45 on rows 14-21 and x=44 on rows 13-23, so the foot steps in to a rounded end. Head column x=0 is rows 16-20 (5 px), stepping out through x=1 and x=2. Taper from ~24 px tall at the head shoulder to 5 px at the tip. No orphan pixels, no opaque fringe, no square ends.

nonBlockingNotes: (a) The window has no left frame. On rows 12-14 the e glass touches the head outline directly (x=4 on row 13, x=3 on row 14), so it reads as cut off by the edge. A 1-px c/b frame column at x=3-4 would tidy it. (b) Three shadow pixels at the bottom-left, (6,29) (8,30) (10,31), sit on the opposite side from the SE shadow; they are harmless as a contact shadow but could be dropped. Neither affects the 1x read.

items.reasons: All five criteria pass. The ends are now rounded: the straight end runs are 5 px at both x=0 and x=46, with stepped-in neighbour columns. The taller body keeps a clear lid/front split and reads as a silver crashed pod in context. The v8 fixes for metal, rivets, crack, window and scorch are intact. Two cosmetic nits are optional: the window's missing left frame and three stray shadow pixels at the bottom-left. Note: this is a visual-QA verdict only. It is not an object-gate receipt, and the 3/4 gate still has to be passed separately.
